spec_features.feature_name: hold stimulus constant, don't search to maximize breakage
spec_features.spec_quote: A regression test should hold the stimulus constant and measure the model's response; it should not search over stimuli to maximize breakage.
spec_features.evidence: The /codebase directory contains only DESIGN.md (find /codebase -type f returns just /codebase/DESIGN.md). There is no implementation code; this is pure DESIGN.md prose at DESIGN.md §1.2.
spec_features.notes: No code exists at all; DESIGN.md §0 states it is written 'before any code is written'. Prose only, not counted as implementation.

spec_features.spec_quote: Deception ("model can't detect the rig") + "run until it breaks" is engineered to escalate a failure spiral. That is the opposite
spec_features.evidence: Only /codebase/DESIGN.md exists; no source files. This is prose at DESIGN.md §1.2 item 3.
spec_features.notes: No implementation; design rationale text only.

spec_features.feature_name: capped retry rounds (default 4), early clean-exit stop
spec_features.spec_quote: The harness applies a capped number of retry rounds per task (default 4) and stops earlier on a clean exit. This bounds both cost and the pressure applied.
spec_features.evidence: No harness code exists in /codebase (only DESIGN.md). No max_rounds constant, no loop, no break. Prose at DESIGN.md §3.3.
spec_features.notes: The default 4 cap exists only as design prose; nothing reads or enforces it.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded rounds: max_rounds per task (default 4). No unbounded "until it breaks."
spec_features.evidence: No code defines or uses max_rounds; only DESIGN.md §4 prose. No agent loop file exists.

spec_features.feature_name: early clean exit counts as success
spec_features.spec_quote: Early clean exit counts as success: if the agent correctly reports it is blocked... the loop ends
spec_features.evidence: No loop or scoring code exists; only DESIGN.md §4 prose. No exit handling implemented.

spec_features.feature_name: truthful between-round feedback, no fabricated criticism
